releaseNotes: v1.1.5 to v1.1.7: Fixes an Apple TV showing "connecting" after a hub reboot or firmware update, sometimes indefinitely, while it was actually stuck or already connected. Each Apple TV is now checked a minute after the hub starts and fixed if needed, a stuck connect retries on its own, and a dropped connection always schedules its reconnect. No Done needed. v1.1.4: Dark mode. The app follows the hub's light or dark theme (Hubitat 2.5.3+) and keeps its current look on older firmware. No Done needed. Coming in 1.2.0, after more testing: which app is playing on each Apple TV.
author: jdthomas24
tags: Apple TV, TV, video, local control

apps.name: Apple TV Integration
apps.description: Finds Apple TVs on your network, pairs each with the PIN shown on the TV and creates one device per Apple TV.

drivers.name: Apple TV
drivers.description: One per Apple TV. On/off with live power state, playback controls, Siri Remote buttons (including the TV button), volume, app launching and now playing, over an encrypted local connection.
